div.head: Wer 5
div.ab: Healsfang gebyreð bearnum, broðrum 7 fæderan; ne gebyreð nanum mæge þæt feoh bute ðam ðe sy binnam cweowe.
Healsfangum debent habere filii, fratres et federan (id est fratres patris); non pertinet alii cognationi pecunia ista nisi illis qui sunt intra cneoƿe (id est genu).
Healsfang gebyreð bearnum, broðrum 7 fæderan; ne gebyreð nanum mæge ðæt feoð bute ðam ðe sy binnan cneowe.
‘Halsfang’ gebührt [des Erschlagenen] Kindern, Brüdern und Vatersbruder [-brüdern?]; dies Geld gebührt keinem Verwandten, ausser dem, der innerhalb des Knies steht.
The healsfang belongs to [the slain man's] children, brothers and father's brother [brothers?]; this money belongs to no kinsman except one who stands within the knee [degree].
Healsfang is due to the children, brothers and fathers; that money is not due to any to any kin except those within the knee.
div.note: B reads ‘binnam cweowe’ (so); Liebermann would correct to ‘cneowe’. H reads ‘feoð’, to be corrected to ‘feoh’.
